title: Native locally finite adic realization data
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and a scheme $X$. Use the native adic module framework [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], the common-field coefficient category [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] and its raw rational stages [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], with the recorded finite-Tor constructibility convention [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. Let $B_X$ be the underlying internal abelian-sheaf ring of the native locally finite coefficient. Define its commutative section-ring sheaf and the section-module functor using the canonical internal/ordinary module equivalence [def-weil-pbc-internal-abelian-sheaf-module-equivalence]. A coefficient presentation fixes the continuous integral completion, finite quotients, localization, integral inclusion and finite-field inclusion by their constants, residues and pointwise values. Its integral structural map is the composite of these specified maps. A realization datum consists of commutativity and exact additive section functor data; all coefficient presentations with scalar compatibility; an additive triangulated common-field functor into the native derived category, fully faithful with exactly the bounded constructible image; its natural integral scalar-extension comparisons; and source/target essential smallness. Require common-field transition maps to be precisely the completion comparison followed by balanced derived scalar multiplication. This defines data and equations, without asserting existence.
